note: Default stance of the website model: the pose of assets/brand/character.png, which is also the stance of the site's relief rig. Each rotation is a joint's local quaternion [x, y, z, w] in the site's axes (+X screen right, +Y up, +Z toward the viewer), from the straight stand of rig-joints.json. export_model.py applies the stance and then gives every joint an identity rest rotation again. How the values were made: each bone takes its direction in the picture from the relief rig's joint table (bodyJoints in website/layers/brand/shared/mascot.ts). The picture gives no depth, so the depth of each bone is a choice. The legs reach floor targets with both soles flat. The head faces the viewer with a roll, because the site's head turn expects that. yaw_radians is the body's turn about the vertical and is already inside the pelvis rotation.
